name: Covenantless
description: The vampire claims no covenant membership and receives no covenant-specific access.

name: Carthian Movement
description: Kindred who apply mortal political ideas to the problems of the dead.

name: Circle of the Crone
description: Acolytes who venerate creation, pain, transformation, and old divinities.

name: Invictus
description: An aristocratic hierarchy that safeguards the Masquerade through tradition and obligation.

name: Lancea et Sanctum
description: A dark faith whose members act as both wolves and shepherds.

name: Ordo Dracul
advantage: Coils and Scales of the Dragon
description: Dragons who seek to transcend the vampiric Curses through study and experimentation.

name: Belial's Brood
description: Spontaneous clutches of ur-predators who embrace monstrosity and violent freedom.

name: Esoteric Order of the Golden Star
translatedName: Esoteric Order of the Golden Star
description: An opportunistic cult of personality disguised as a tradition of blood sorcery.

name: Gallows Post
description: A late-medieval messenger network and highway gang maintaining safe passage between Kindred domains.

name: Weihan Cynn
description: Ancient British woods-witches who bargain with other supernatural creatures.

name: Ahl al-Mumit
description: Wrathful soldiers who hunt those who revel in monstrosity.

name: al-Amin
description: Record keepers and traditionalists who uphold law and mediate the All Night Society.

name: Fir'awn
description: Apostates and pagans who seek wisdom through older faiths and strange rites.

name: Jaliniyya
description: Students of occult science who pursue practical blood alchemy.

name: Legion of the Green
description: Feudal knights who fought against and alongside the fae Courts of Britannia.

name: Tenth Choir
description: Blasphemers who drink the essence of angels and seek to overthrow divine authority.

name: Architects of the Monolith
description: Masons who reshape cities, ley lines, and social currents in pursuit of their planned Monolith.

name: Followers of Seth
description: An ancient Shadow Cult that uses deliberate chaos and blood sorcery to oppose supernatural stagnation and incursion.

name: Inconnu
description: Monitors who worship and preserve the Masquerade by discarding their identities and assuming perfected covers.

name: Moirai
description: Secretive Mekhet seers who read and cut the threads of possible futures before threats can emerge.

name: The Moulding Room
description: A surveillance cult whose ritualized voyeurism and bodily sacrifices turn stolen information into supernatural power.

name: Children of the Thorns
advantage: Treated as a Mystery Cult only; the Schism, Crypt/Egress system, Grave Attendant, Sacred Explorer, and Touched by Mary are excluded.
description: A funerary Acolyte cult devoted to the mysteries beneath the earth.
source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone

name: Faithful of Propylaia
advantage: Mystery Cult Initiation grants Tolerance for Biology; a Crafts (Butchery) or Occult (Offerings) Specialty; a Socialize or Subterfuge dot; Iron Will against doubt; and, at five dots, perception of the dead or free Arcane Sight for vampires.
description: A Shadow Cult venerating the dead through sacrifice, thresholds, and the rites of Propylaia.
source: Agony & Ecstasy: Circle of the Crone
